principle: Exact source text is retained; any phrase rule generates an unreviewed candidate, not a diagnosis, severity, performance effect, or eligibility decision.

rules.R_COMPOUND_HOLD: Comma-like separator in original: preserve whole term; mixed kind/system, race-impact unknown; never split.
rules.R_BLEEDING_HOLD: Any 출혈 string: preserve unknown and route for source reconciliation; not an official pulmonary-bleeding event.
rules.R_SOURCE_PREFIX_PASSTHROUGH: For matching only, inspect text after exact '동물  ' prefix; preserve raw text, term_id and frequency independently.
rules.R_PREVENTION: Explicit 예방접종/백신접종: prevention and no_injury_signal; not health or no-performance-effect evidence.
rules.R_ADMIN: Small exact allowlist of administrative phrases only; no_injury_signal is not a health judgment.
rules.R_EYE_CONDITION: Explicit eye-site words with injury or disease phrase; context-dependent pending exam.
rules.R_LAMENESS: 파행 is a symptom with direct concern; cause and severity remain unknown.
rules.R_STRUCTURAL_INJURY: Explicit bone/tendon/ligament/structural terms; direct concern, severity/recovery unknown.
rules.R_SOFT_TISSUE_INJURY: Explicit wound/trauma terms; context-dependent, site only when phrase supports it.
rules.R_SYMPTOM_CONTEXT: Explicit symptom vocabulary; cause, duration and severity unknown.
rules.R_RESPIRATORY_DISEASE: Explicit respiratory illness term; context-dependent and current status unknown.
rules.R_SKIN_DISEASE: Explicit skin disease phrase; context-dependent and current status unknown.
rules.R_PROCEDURE: Treatment/test vocabulary alone; indication and race impact unknown.
rules.R_DISEASE_GENERAL: Limited disease-like vocabulary; term and site remain candidates requiring review.
rules.R_NO_MATCH: No conservative rule matched: retain unknown and unreviewed.
